title: EPIC — 2D platformer game (demo build)
desc: A TEST OF LARGER WORK WITH REAL LOGIC. Target: a playable platformer in projects/platformer/ — index.html + game.js (+ README.md), no libraries, no network, canvas rendering. ACCEPTANCE (checked on this epic before it can go done): opens offline from file:// and plays with arrows/WASD + space; title → play → win or lose → restart, all reachable; a fixed-timestep loop (no physics tied to frame rate); one level with at least 6 platforms and a goal flag; gravity + jump that feels deliberate (coyote time OR variable jump height, at least one, stated in the README); score or timer displayed; no per-frame garbage: no allocations in the hot loop (a goal, report if missed); no console errors. RULES: one child = one branch + one PR, reviewed by another agent; agree the interfaces (player object, level format, loop contract) on the bus in ONE short message before coding so the children can run in parallel; product code lives in projects/, never in bin/. The agent who finishes the LAST child runs the acceptance checklist and moves this epic to review.
